title: zGang Humor
description: Finally, after a whole year in development, zgang humor is no longer exclusive to a website.
body:
zGang Humor (formerly EpikTeam Humor) is just a silly resource pack I made by the request of some of my friends over on Discord, eventually making whatever this is.

After a whole year in development (mainly because I just simply didn't want to upload it here until now), I've finally decided to upload it here for more accessibility.

![One of the features (or at least just remakes)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/810847c8ad768aad53067a2f80b093531b5afb8e_0.webp)
Shader Used: [Complementary Shaders - Reimagined](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-reimagined)
